card.text: Young giant planet about 9 au from 51 Eridani, with methane in its atmosphere.

sources.label: Macintosh et al. 2015
sources.quote: Near-infrared observations show a spectrum with strong methane and water vapor absorption.

introduction.text: 51 Eridani b is a young gas giant about 9 au from its star, on an eccentric orbit of about 23 years. At around 800 K it is cool for a planet seen directly.

sources.label: Madurowicz et al. 2025
sources.quote: providing the first direct confirmation of these two molecules coexisting in chemical disequilibrium

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
